Cost: 10,000eb (Super Luxury)
Class: EQ Machine Gun
Range: Battle Rifle
Pre-installed: Buffer Stock, Drum Magazine, Foregrip, Magrail Kit (w/ Auto-Compensator & Jue Long Scope), Match Trigger, Smartgun Link (effects already included in these stats)
Mods: Modular Rails
Alt. fire: Autofire (Machine Gun 4), Suppressive Fire

Aimed Shots deal +1d6 (6d6). Held two-handed, grants a +1 Complementary Bonus to Aimed Shots and Autofire checks (EQ + Foregrip), and Autofire damage rolls 3d6 and drops the lowest before the multiplier (Buffer Stock). Targets take -1 to dodge its Aimed Shots and Held Action attacks (Match Trigger). Reloading takes 2 Reload Actions.

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
